comment: Approved divergences for the v2-to-v3 parity harness (#673).
Every entry pins the EXACT divergence it approves: boundary, fixture(s),
config key, and the expected old AND new values (for outcome-level drift,
the 'ok' / 'error:<category>' tokens). An approval never extends beyond
the pinned fixture and value pair: if v3 starts returning a different
wrong value for an approved key, the harness fails. Drift on any
fixture/key/value not pinned here fails the run.

entries.reason: Tier representation change: v3 resolves the primary tier's api format at config time (resolveInherited, inheriting 'openai'); v2 left it empty and fell back at call time (classification.sh PRIMARY_* resolution). The effective call-time value is identical.

Tier representation change: v3 resolves the primary tier's api format at config time (resolveInherited, inheriting the configured 'anthropic'); v2 left it empty and fell back at call time. The effective call-time value is identical.

#811: the v3 contract default for verdict-policy is 'strict' — the published verdict is derived deterministically from the still-open findings and coverage. v2's default (and the explicit v3 opt-out) is 'model' passthrough, so every fixture that leaves verdict_policy unset resolves differently by design.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves aiPrimaryBaseUrl from aiBaseUrl in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and classification.sh fell back at call time. The effective call-time value is identical.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves aiPrimaryModel from aiModel in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and classification.sh fell back at call time. The effective call-time value is identical.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves aiSmartApiFormat from aiApiFormat ('openai') in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and fell back at call time. The effective call-time value is identical.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves aiSmartApiFormat from aiApiFormat ('anthropic') in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and fell back at call time. The effective call-time value is identical.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves aiSmartBaseUrl from aiBaseUrl in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and fell back at call time. The effective call-time value is identical.

Secret presence representation: v3 inherits the primary tier's api key from the primary key at config time; v2 left it empty and the transport fell back at call time. Secrets are compared by redacted presence only.

Secret presence representation: v3 inherits the smart tier's api key from the primary key at config time; v2 left it empty and the transport fell back at call time. Secrets are compared by redacted presence only.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves primaryModelContextTokens from modelContextTokens (200000) in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and apply_context_limits fell back to the identical global budget.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves smartModelContextTokens from modelContextTokens (200000) in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and apply_context_limits fell back to the identical global budget.

v2 inherits the Forgejo token from the GitHub token through the action.yml env expression (inputs.forgejo_token || inputs.github_token); the v3 loader does not inherit it. The #681 cutover must re-wire this fallback in the v3 composite env block; pinned here so the gap stays visible until then.

v2 degrades each unrecognized enum-shaped dial to its default with an ERROR log and continues the review (ai_response_format->off, verdict_policy->model, review_verbosity->normal after lowercasing, tool_mode->off including the removed plan_execute_* names from #304); the v3 contract validates enums strictly at resolution time and rejects the input.

v2 degrades malformed or out-of-range numeric inputs to their defaults with an ERROR log and continues (ai_max_tokens->8192, ai_temperature->0.1, tool_min_successful_requests->0, repo_map_max_bytes->12000 within the same 1..200000 bounds); the v3 contract rejects them at resolution time.

v2 normalized the api format case-insensitively (normalize_api_format lowercases before validating); the v3 contract accepts only the exact declared enum values and rejects anything else at resolution time.

#680 removes the v2 coexistence bridge: when the model emitted no structured required-check dispositions at all, v2 fell back to the legacy shallow keyword match against review_markdown (documented in pr_reviewer/completeness.py as removed by #680). The v3 pipeline is structured-authoritative: key absence is conservatively unresolved (every check unresolved, warn/fail modes act on it). Pinned per key with the exact old and new values.

entries.reason: #706 PR 6 intentional change (#807 review): v2's render_ci_checks interpolates external check names raw into the ci-checks-context.md Markdown table (jq "| \(.name) | \(.state) |"), so a CI-configured name containing |, a newline plus a forged '## heading', or control characters splits rows and injects corpus structure the final reviewer treats as authoritative CI evidence. The v3 CI gate escapes every cell (escapeTableCell): control/line-separator runs collapse to one space, \ | and backticks are backslash-escaped, & < > become entities, so the table keeps exactly one row per check.

v3 recommended default (#706): tool-max-tokens-per-turn 16384 (v2 400); reasoning models need room to emit the tool call.
v3 recommended default (#706): tool-mode native_loop (v2 off); evidence gathering is on by default and degrades without tool calls.
